name: libraryTop
signature: export function libraryTop(state: GameState, playerId: PlayerId, count: number): InstanceId[]
rules: CR 401.1 the library is an ordered zone
CR 701.18a scry looks at the top N
CR 701.44a surveil looks at the top N
contract: Returns the first count entries of the player's library, which is stored top-first.
A count larger than the library returns the whole library. CR 701.18a says look at the top N, and looking at fewer than N because there are fewer is not an error.
A count of zero or less returns empty.
It returns a NEW array. Returning the live library array would let a caller reorder a library by accident, which is the mutation the purity gate exists to catch.

assertions.expect: the first two ids, top first

assertions.given: the returned array is then sorted by the caller
assertions.expect: the library in state is unchanged

unlocks.source: supporting primitive for P08 and P09
